# Test libraries

Two kinds of fixture live here: one library that builds cleanly, and five that
must not build at all.

The images are generated by `make-library.sh` and **committed as bytes**. CI
never runs the script: a clone tests against the same pixels everywhere, with no
ImageMagick in the loop. Run the script by hand when the fixtures need to
change, and commit what it produces.

Nothing here is a photograph. They are gradients with their own filename written
across them, sized so the derivative ladder has something to do — a 900px long
edge renders 200, 400 and 800 and stops, because `ladder()` never upscales.

## `library/` — the good one

Every photograph covers something. That mapping is the fixture's whole purpose;
a library of pretty pictures would test nothing in particular.

| Photograph | Covers |
|---|---|
| `2024/03/harbour-dawn.jpg` | the complete case: title, caption, album, place, curated tag, gear, and the album's cover. Its caption carries Markdown — emphasis and a link — so R-4's rendering and D-9's plain `alt` are both exercised |
| `2024/03/harbour-boats.jpg` | no title and no caption, so D-9's alt text falls back to the id. Its lens is written `7-14/F4.0`, the form with no `mm` that F-24's focal parser has to handle |
| `2024/03/harbour-crane.jpg` | 3:1, the wide end of D-4's rows |
| `2024/07/fjord-wall.jpg` | 9:16, narrower than 2:3 — the only shape a grid crops |
| `2024/07/fjord-water.jpg` | second member of the unlisted album (F-18); its caption carries raw HTML, which R-4 drops rather than renders |
| `2023/11/street-lamp.jpg` | R-7: a flat tag and a `darktable|` tag, both filtered, beside a namespaced one that survives |
| `inbox/copy-of-lamp.jpg` | R-12: the same bytes at a second path, curated identically, collapsed into one photograph |
| `2022/05/rejected.jpg` | rating 3 — below the gate (R-5) |
| `2022/05/untouched.jpg` | no sidecar at all: not a violation, counted and reported |
| `2024/12/square-window.jpg` | 1:1, and a lens shared with `harbour-dawn` so a gear page holds more than one photograph |
| `2025/01/dock-detail.jpg` | three levels of hierarchy (R-6), rendered with `»` |
| `2025/01/scanned-print.jpg` | no camera and no lens in EXIF, so no gear tags (R-15); its album is its only curated path, so emptying that listing strands it and nothing else |

`_data/` carries an album with a cover and an unlisted one (R-3, F-18), a place
with coordinates and one deliberately without (R-10, R-11), a standalone page
(R-13), a gear description (R-17), a description of the `Subject|Street` tag
with Markdown emphasis in it (R-19) and a featured list (R-16).

Expected: **11 photographs, 9 published, 1 without a sidecar, 1 duplicate
collapsed, 2 albums, 2 locations of which 1 is mappable, 3 featured.**

## `broken/` — the ones that must fail

A build that is meant to fail loudly needs a test proving it does. Each library
trips exactly one failure, and carries one valid photograph so nothing else can
be blamed.

| Library | Fails with | Stage |
|---|---|---|
| `no-capture-date/` | `no capture date` (R-8) | index |
| `no-path/` | `no tags, album or location` (R-8) | index |
| `duplicate-conflict/` | same bytes, different metadata (R-12) | index |
| `unknown-featured/` | a featured path that is not in the library (R-16) | index |
| `unknown-gear/` | a gear description naming no camera or lens (R-17) | **content** |
| `unknown-tag/` | a tag description naming no tag (R-19) | **content** |

The last two fail later than the others because their checks need the tags,
which only exist once the index has been read.
